_provenance: gamma = -mean(NN stacking dG37), SantaLucia 1998 nearest-neighbour stacking (the SAME read-only metric used by the DNA volume and the neuro chain). Values are extracted VERBATIM (read-only, never fitted) from the neuro package data files repro/neuro/_engine/data/{sensory_organ_gamma.json, spinal_master_genes.json}, which fetched the master-gene promoter window [TSS-2000, TSS+500] (2501 bp, coding strand) from NCBI RefSeq (GRCh38). corr(gamma, GC) = 0.994-0.995 across that atlas. Layer-1 [F] uses gamma; absolute organ size/time is Layer-2 [O].

cerebrum.note: FOXG1 specifies the telencephalon, including the dorsal cortex; canonical forebrain master.

cerebellum.note: EN1 patterns the mid-hindbrain boundary that gives rise to the cerebellum.

hypothalamus.note: SIM1 is the canonical master for paraventricular/supraoptic hypothalamic nuclei.

hippocampus.note: LHX2 controls the cortical hem and hippocampal-field allocation. The dentate-gyrus-specific master PROX1 is a Layer-2 [O] refinement (gamma not re-fetched here).
